claims: Marshalls is closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
All stores operated by the TJX Companies—including T.J. Maxx, HomeGoods, Homesense, and Sierra—are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026 to give employees the day off.
Online shopping remains available through the TJX Companies' website on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Marshalls stores will resume normal operating hours on Monday, April 6, 2026.
